name: Matilde Gaststein
original_name: マティルデ・ガストシュタイン
source:
Princess of Neo Capricorn.
Likes: Anything nutritional, she does not care about the taste of food.
Dislikes: Funny things, stuffed things.
Hobbies: Taking walks, creating wings to fly in the sky.
